title: Test names with independent range and standard adapters
problem: Verify cross-feature composition without making optional adapters depend on each other.
design: Integration-only fixtures sit above independent feature branches.
tradeoffs:
Named argument wrappers preserve the referenced family's mutability and provide
runtime names for outer width fields. The interaction tests combine names with
ranges and standard-type adapters. Each family and named arguments also has an
independent test suite, so this integration adds no prerequisite between those
features.

source_provenance.source_changes: Only existing named-range, named-complex and mutable named-range interaction tests moved into a dedicated suite. No library implementation source.

before: Independent names/ranges/std suites do not verify named widths on optional adapters or mutable named ranges.

validation.results: Pending validation of the assembled intermediate commit; root records exact commands and outcomes.
validation.limitations: Portable checks do not establish accelerator runtime availability. No hardware campaign rerun is warranted by whitespace/comments, helper renaming and test decomposition alone.
